test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

A gentleman _________ as to what success meant to me.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Inquired.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is** 1) inquired.**
 
• **Inquired** means** to ask for information from someone.**
 
• In this context, the gentleman asked the speaker about what success meant to them.
 
 
• Example: The journalist inquired </stron
